Here are the quantitative parameters and values extracted from the text:

1. **$l_i$**: Intracellular concentration of signaling molecules due to IL-2 signals.
2. **$l_e$**: Extracellular concentration of IL-2 at the coordinate $x_i$.
3. **$n_T$**: Number of molecules internalized by T cell receptors.
4. **$C_i$**: Intracellular concentration of signaling molecules due to IFN signals.
5. **$C_e$**: Extracellular concentration of IFN at the coordinate $x_i$.
6. **$C_i^*$**: Critical level of $C_i$ for cell fate decisions.
7. **$l_i^*$**: Critical level of $l_i$ for cell fate decisions.
8. **$T$**: Duration of cell cycle, given as a random variable in the interval $[T - \tau, T + \tau]$.
9. **$D_{IL}$**: Diffusion coefficient for IL-2.
10. **$W_{IL}$**: Rate of IL-2 production by CD4+ T cells.
11. **$b_1$**: Rate of IL-2 consumption and degradation.
12. **$\rho_{IL}$**: Constant production rate of IL-2 by mature CD4+ T cells.
13. **$D_{IFN}$**: Diffusion coefficient for type I IFN.
14. **$W_{IFN}$**: Rate of type I IFN production by APC cells.
15. **$b_2$**: Rate of type I IFN consumption and degradation.
16. **$\rho_{IFN}$**: Constant production rate of type I IFN by APC cells.
17. **$N_{ef}$**: Level of CD8+ T cells (effector cells) in the body.
18. **$k_1$**: Rate constant for production of effector cells in the lymph nodes.
19. **$k_2$**: Rate constant for death of effector cells in the body.
20. **$N_{inf}$**: Number of virus-infected cells.
21. **$k_3$**: Rate constant for elimination of infected cells by effector cells.
22. **$a$**: Positive constant in the function $f(N_{inf})$.
23. **$h$**: Positive constant in the function $f(N_{inf})$.
